search_text: published ZDI-13-227 ZDI-CAN-1744 HP PCM+ GetEventsServlet SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-09-11 CVE-2013-4809 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2013-4809 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['PCM Plus'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP PCM Plus. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetEventsServlet. This servlet contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the sort and dir arguments. This can result in remote code execution under the context of the SYSTEM user. ['2013-02-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2013-09-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-13-227/
title: HP PCM+ GetEventsServlet SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP PCM Plus. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetEventsServlet. This servlet contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the sort and dir arguments. This can result in remote code execution under the context of the SYSTEM user.
